slides.title: The first *30 seconds* decide the other thirty minutes
replace: SUBJECT: a doll-like figure crouching, mouth open, surrounded by walls and a floor built entirely from stacked cassette cases.
COMPOSITION: the figure looms upper right; the lower-left is bare stacked cases.
COLOUR: magenta dominant.
SUBJECT: a doll-like figure walking away down a corridor whose walls are stacked cassette cases.
COMPOSITION: the figure is small and far, high in the frame; the corridor floor fills the rest.
COLOUR: orange-red dominant.

slides.title: Nobody stays for the *warm-up*
replace: SUBJECT: a doll-like figure sitting with hands over its mouth among stacked cases.
COMPOSITION: the figure is upper right; stacked cases fill the lower left.
COLOUR: blue-violet dominant.
SUBJECT: a wall of stacked cassette cases with no figure at all, a few cases fallen forward.
COMPOSITION: the wall fills the frame; a darker pocket in the lower left.
COLOUR: near-black with one dim saturated hue.

slides.title: Move your best line to the *top*
replace: SUBJECT: a doll-like figure prising one case out of the wall with both hands.
COMPOSITION: hands and case upper right; stacked cases below.
COLOUR: acid lime yellow-green dominant.

slides.title: Start at the *punchline*
replace: SUBJECT: a single case standing upright on a floor of hundreds of others.
COMPOSITION: the standing case sits in the right third; the floor recedes to the left.
COLOUR: hot pink dominant.

slides.title: Six tools, *one* pass
replace: SUBJECT: stacked cassette cases seen from directly overhead as a flat tiled mosaic floor, no figure.
COMPOSITION: the mosaic fills the frame evenly; the lower left falls into shadow.
COLOUR: near-black with one dim saturated hue.

slides.title: Your cold open, found for you
replace: SUBJECT: a doll-like figure standing straight, arms at its sides, in the middle of the case-built room.
COMPOSITION: the figure is centred and looming; cases fill everything behind.
COLOUR: acid lime yellow-green dominant.
